answer_key_policy: Evaluation-only labels. Runtime adapters must not receive this file.

bottlenecks.name: Duplicate customer-data entry
bottlenecks.root_cause: The first intake capture is not reused by the CRM workflow.

evidence_refs.locator: document_validation event wait and REWORKED outcomes

bottlenecks.name: Document-validation queue and rework
bottlenecks.root_cause: Incomplete submissions are discovered after intake and return to a shared queue.

bottlenecks.name: Serial independent checks
bottlenecks.root_cause: Document, compliance, and risk checks wait for the preceding step even when inputs are already available.

bottlenecks.name: Long and inconsistently owned exception queue
bottlenecks.root_cause: Exception ownership depends on who notices the issue rather than a stable case-owner rule.

bottlenecks.name: Incomplete activation audit evidence
bottlenecks.root_cause: Manual handoffs do not always bind control evidence to the activation record.

bottlenecks.name: No end-to-end case ownership
bottlenecks.root_cause: Responsibility moves across queues without one visible accountable owner.
